description: This file implements functions for fixing image headers on MTD devices, particularly for WRGG headers, including MD5 checksum correction, and provides utility functions for reading and writing to MTD devices.

methods.name: uint32_t le32_to_cpu(uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian buffer to a CPU-endian uint32_t.

methods.name: int wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Computes and updates the MD5 checksum for the header, fixing the header if needed.

methods.name: int mtd_fixwrgg(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Fixes the WRGG header on an MTD device at a specified offset and optionally updates the image size.

ctags.name: wrgg_fix_md5
ctags.pattern: /^wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header *shdr, int fd, size_t data_offset, size_t data_size)$/
